info.title: Thomas Creek Hub
info.description: Home-side service for the Thomas Creek app. Holds every credential, enforces roles.

get.description: Unauthenticated: lets the app check it found the right hub.

Unauthenticated: who this hub is, plus the SHA-256 of its TLS public key
(the same `pin` as the Bonjour TXT record) so a phone that typed the address
can check it reached the right hub before trusting the certificate.

post.description:
First open on home Wi-Fi: register this phone. Nothing to scan or type.

Being on the home network is the proof of belonging. A new phone is
`pending` (the child's limits, no room) until Dylan says whose it is.

Hub actions (who did what in the app) merged with Home Assistant's logbook
for doors, locks, garage, presence and automations. Newest first.

`before` is the `next_before` of the previous page (an opaque string).
Dylan's view of the Firewalla clients the hub hands out.

internet on until someone pauses it.
